Microduck 02B: learned IMU reflex replay

Recorded simulator states (CPU MuJoCo + upstream BAM XL330 model), 50 Hz, played back without re-simulation. Blue: link frames along the kinematic tree, circle = head centre of mass. Soles: floor footprint, filled while touching the floor. Orange: whole-body COM and its floor projection. Stick figure only; no robot meshes are embedded.

Side view (x forward → right, z up)
Front view (y left → left, z up)
Top view: support footprints and COM projection (x up, y left)
